_note: Hand-written training scenarios. posId values refer to src/data/posMenu.json. Guests speak in customer-menu language only.

scenarios.title: Premium AYCE Dinner (full table)
scenarios.summary: Seat a party of four, send two AYCE rounds, then take a credit card payment and close the check.

stages.speaker: host
stages.say: I have a party of four. Please seat them in your section, A B C BAR, any open table.
We'll all do Premium All You Can Eat. Can we get two Cokes, one Sprite, and a draft Sapporo? Let's start with two briskets, one beef bulgogi, and one pork belly.

stages.note: A little later, the grill is empty.
stages.say: Can we get two more pork bellies and two more briskets?
Can we get the check, please? We'll put it all on one card.

scenarios.title: AYCE and Drinks Together
scenarios.summary: A party of four orders AYCE, drinks, and the first meat round all at once.

stages.speaker: host
stages.say: Party of four for you. Seat them in M Y W, please.
We'll all do Premium AYCE. Can we get two Cokes, one Sprite, and a draft Sapporo? For meat, let's start with two briskets and two pork bellies.

scenarios.title: AYCE First, Drinks Later
scenarios.summary: Send the AYCE order, then reopen the table to add drinks.

stages.speaker: host
stages.say: Two guests. Put them anywhere in A B C BAR.
We'll both do Premium AYCE. Let's start with brisket and beef bulgogi.

stages.note: You walk by a few minutes later.
stages.say: Oh, can we also get a Coke and a draft Asahi?

scenarios.title: Drinks First
scenarios.summary: Send drinks first, then come back for the AYCE order.

stages.speaker: host
stages.say: Party of three, M Y W section please.
Can we start with two Cokes and an iced tea while we look at the menu?

stages.note: You come back with the drinks.
stages.say: We're ready! Premium All You Can Eat for all three of us. To start: ribeye, garlic chicken, and miso pork belly.

scenarios.title: Weekday Lunch AYCE
scenarios.summary: Tuesday lunch: pick the right AYCE package for the meal period, and ring the AYCE version of an appetizer.

stages.speaker: host
stages.say: Lunch table for two, A B C BAR section.
We'll both do the all you can eat lunch. Brisket and beef bulgogi to start, plus a steamed egg. And two hot teas, please.

scenarios.title: Additional Meat Rounds + Cash
scenarios.summary: Three meat rounds on one table, then a cash payment with change.

stages.speaker: host
stages.say: Three guests, A B C BAR section.
Premium AYCE for the three of us. Two briskets, a pork belly, and a chicken bulgogi to start.
Can we get two more briskets, one pork belly, and one beef bulgogi?
Last round for us: one spicy pork and one pork jowl.
Check please. Here's $140 in cash.

scenarios.title: Family With Kids
scenarios.summary: Two adults and two children: use the children's AYCE prices.

stages.speaker: host
stages.say: Family of four, M Y W please.
We'll do Premium all you can eat for everyone. Our daughter is 7 and our son is 10. Two lemonades for the kids. And to start, two briskets, a chicken breast, and a pork belly.
We're all set. Card, please.

scenarios.title: À la carte Dinner + Cash
scenarios.summary: No AYCE: an entrée, an appetizer and two drinks, paid in cash.

stages.speaker: host
stages.say: Two for dinner, A B C BAR section.
We're not doing all you can eat tonight. We'll share the galbi entrée and the Korean fried chicken. And a Coke and a Terra.
Here's a hundred. Can I get change?

scenarios.title: Guest Changes the Order Mid-Entry
scenarios.summary: Fix quantities and add an item before sending.

stages.speaker: host
stages.say: Two guests, M Y W section.
Premium AYCE for both of us. Two briskets and two pork bellies, please.

interrupt.say: Oh wait, sorry. Just one pork belly, and add a ribeye instead.

scenarios.title: Cancel an Appetizer Before Sending
scenarios.summary: À la carte appetizers and drinks; the guest cancels and swaps items before you press Order.

stages.speaker: host
stages.say: Three guests for drinks and appetizers, A B C BAR section.
We're just snacking. Can we get the mandu, the fried calamari, and the japchae? And three Cokes.

interrupt.say: Actually, cancel the calamari. And make one of those Cokes a Sprite.

scenarios.title: Single Guest AYCE
scenarios.summary: One guest orders AYCE: remember the single-guest charge.

stages.speaker: host
stages.say: Party of one. Seat them at BAR 2, please.
Just me tonight. I'll do the Premium all you can eat. I know there's an extra charge for one person, that's fine. Brisket and ribeye to start.
I'm done, thank you! Card is fine.

scenarios.title: Ultimate AYCE
scenarios.summary: Ultimate package with Ultimate-only items from the AYCE ULTIMATE group.

stages.speaker: host
stages.say: Two guests, M Y W section.
We want the Ultimate all you can eat. Let's start with the galbi, beef tongue, scallops, and a brisket.
That was amazing. Here's my card.

scenarios.title: Over the 4-Meat Limit
scenarios.summary: The guests ask for five meats at once. Apply the AYCE rule and send the rest next round.

stages.speaker: host
stages.say: Four guests, A B C BAR section.
Premium AYCE for all four. Can we get two briskets, two pork bellies, and one beef bulgogi?
stages.question: That is five meat orders. What do you do?

options.text: Ring in all five so the table isn't kept waiting
options.feedback: AYCE is limited to 4 meat items per order per table at a time.

options.text: Explain the limit of 4 meats per round, send 4 now, and send the last one in the next round
options.feedback: Right. The limit is per table, per round. The remaining meat goes in with the next round.

options.text: Tell them they have to choose only four and drop the fifth
options.feedback: Guests can still have the fifth meat; it just has to wait for the next round.

stages.say: Okay, no problem. Send what you can.

stages.note: The first plates are on the grill.
stages.say: Can we get the rest of what we asked for? And add a corn cheese.

scenarios.title: Cancel After Sending + Cash
scenarios.summary: Void an item that was already ordered, then take cash.

stages.speaker: host
stages.say: Two guests, A B C BAR section.
Two Premium AYCE. A Coke and a Sprite. Start us with brisket and pork belly.
Sorry, can you cancel the Sprite? I'll just have water.
We're ready to pay. Here's $100.

scenarios.title: Party of Six (Gratuity)
scenarios.summary: Large party: 18% gratuity applies to parties of 5 or more.

stages.speaker: host
stages.say: Party of six. M Y W section.
All six of us want Premium AYCE. Three Cokes and a pitcher of Sapporo. First round: two briskets, one spicy pork bulgogi, and one wine pork belly.
Next round: two seasoned short ribs and two red pepper pork bellies.
We'll put it all on one card.

scenarios.title: Two Tables at Once
scenarios.summary: Manage two parties in different sections; ring and pay on the right table.

stages.speaker: host
stages.say: First party: two guests in A B C BAR.
(Party of two) Premium AYCE for both. Two Cokes. Brisket and beef bulgogi to start.

stages.speaker: host
stages.say: Second party: four guests, M Y W section.
(Party of four) Drinks first: a pitcher of Asahi and a bottle of peach soju.
(Party of two) Can we get another brisket and a pork belly?
(Party of four) We'll all do Premium AYCE. Two ribeyes, a pork belly, and a garlic chicken.
(Party of two) We're done. Here's $100 cash.
(Party of four) Check please, one card.

scenarios.title: AYCE Policy: Whole Table
scenarios.summary: One guest doesn't want AYCE. Apply the house rule.

stages.speaker: host
stages.say: Three guests, A B C BAR section.
Two of us want the all you can eat, but our friend isn't that hungry. Can she just get a bibimbap?
stages.question: How do you respond?

options.text: Sure: ring two Premium AYCE and one bibimbap
options.feedback: All party members must order the same AYCE choice; mixing AYCE and à la carte at one table isn't allowed.

options.text: Explain that everyone at the table must order the same AYCE, otherwise the table orders from the à la carte menu
options.feedback: That's the house rule printed on the AYCE menu.

options.text: Ring three AYCE without saying anything
options.feedback: Never charge guests for something they did not agree to. Explain the rule and let them choose.

stages.say: Okay, makes sense. We'll all do Premium then. Start with two briskets and a beef bulgogi.

scenarios.title: AYCE Policy: Disability Exception
scenarios.summary: A guest with a disability cannot take part in AYCE. Per Janchi policy this is the one exception.

stages.speaker: host
stages.say: Three guests, M Y W section.
My brother has a disability and can't eat grilled food. Can he order a soon tofu while the two of us do Premium AYCE?
stages.question: How do you respond?

options.text: Tell them all three must order AYCE or the table goes à la carte
options.feedback: Janchi makes an exception to the same-AYCE rule for guests with disabilities.

options.text: Accommodate: two Premium AYCE and one soon tofu entrée
options.feedback: Guests with disabilities are the one exception to the whole-table AYCE rule.

options.text: Ask them to prove the disability first
options.feedback: Never ask a guest to prove a disability.

stages.say: Thank you! So two Premium AYCE and his soon tofu. Brisket and pork belly to start.

scenarios.title: Saturday Lunch Pricing
scenarios.summary: It's lunchtime on a Saturday. The AYCE lunch price is weekdays only.

stages.speaker: host
stages.say: Two for lunch, A B C BAR section.
Two Premium all you can eat, please. Pork belly and garlic chicken to start, and two Diet Cokes.

scenarios.title: Combo for Three
scenarios.summary: An à la carte combo order with drinks, paid by card.

stages.speaker: host
stages.say: Three guests, M Y W section.
We'll get the Combo M to share. A bottle of yogurt soju and two Coke Zeros.
Card, please.
